criteria.criterion: Provide independently selectable LIM-r, new depth prediction plus sky-mask repair, and measured scene range plus finite sky shell preprocessing, with own manifests and timing; no Gaussian fitting or training in preprocessing.

New modules are package-local and independently callable from CLI and array APIs without importing the research repository. Preserve existing depth repair, finite ray intersection, sky accumulation/coverage and measured range formulas; document inputs, outputs and optional calibrated/mask dependencies.

Verify module selections and default compatibility, meaningful numerical invariants/parity, and real input limited-frame fresh depth prediction/mask/sky export and readback. Explicitly disclose any reused calibration or depth as non-cold and do not invent full-scene PSNR or timing results.

Keep PFG-v5 current, default VR-v1-y-equivalent LIM-r plus VR-v1-s reconstruction and frozen historical assets unchanged; add documentation and algorithm changelog for optional preprocessing. No delivery promotion.
